confirmed_facts: Raw st_river_r.xlsx and the platform workbook agree for all 17520 target-year hours.
The database maps CGB087012 to the gauge name Xufan; the spatial registry uses section 70115800 named Xufan (II).
Reservoir-operation tables in xufan.mdb are empty and Regulater.dat contains no station codes.
Several rainfall gauges are reservoir-named, but no release or storage series is supplied.
unresolved_items: Confirm whether CGB087012 and registered section 70115800 are the same control-section record series.
Provide measured-versus-interpolated quality flags for the long monotonic flow segments in 2014 and 2017.
Confirm whether all-zero station months mean measured zero rain or absence of continuous observations.
Confirm whether upstream reservoir releases materially affect the Xufan hydrograph and provide operation records if so.
